strict-dynamic-unsafe-inline.note: 'strict-dynamic' switches 'unsafe-inline' off, for scripts and for handlers

strict-dynamic-hash.note: a hash still allows an inline script under 'strict-dynamic'

unsafe-hashes-without-the-handler-hash.note: 'unsafe-hashes' allows only handlers whose own hash is listed

unsafe-hashes-with-the-handler-hash.note: the handler's hash, over its attribute value

unsafe-hashes-entity-decoded.note: the hash is of the attribute value after " is decoded

javascript-url-hash-only.note: a javascript: link runs only under 'unsafe-inline'

javascript-url-unsafe-hashes.note: whether 'unsafe-hashes' and the URL's hash let a javascript: link run

meta-after-the-script.note: a meta policy governs only what is parsed after it

meta-in-the-body.note: a meta policy outside <head> is ignored

meta-report-only.note: report-only in a meta tag is ignored altogether

meta-comma.note: a comma in a <meta> policy: two policies (blocked), or one with stray tokens?

meta-comma-reversed.note: the same, the other way round: blocked again means both halves are enforced

noscript.note: a script inside <noscript> is text when scripting is on; it never runs (and is never checked)

comment.note: a script inside a comment never runs

handler-text-inside-a-script.note: an onerror= inside a script's string is not a handler

legacy-javascript-type.note: text/jscript is a JavaScript type, so it runs and is checked like any script

legacy-javascript-type-no-policy.note: with no policy at all: does text/jscript run?

type-with-parameters.note: a type with parameters is not a JavaScript MIME type essence match; with no policy at all, it does not run
